posts.title: Major Lance: The Monkey Time
posts.description: One of the most remarkable Democrat victories in their midterm landslide was in Georgia, where Keisha Lance Bottoms became the first black woman to be elected as a state governor. She also became, at once, Georgia's first black governor and first woman governor.
